text:
sara_partnerships: Heads-up 1000 - planning a quick preflight for the cloud marketplace listing. Need to align legal, SKU packaging, trial policy, and credential handoff before we open the publisher form. Who's available to split tasks?
mark_sales: I can drive SKU names and the pricing tiers. will draft a short rationale for each tier.
alan_product: Proposed tiers: 'Starter', 'Team', 'Scale' but with clearer feature bullets. Suggest Starter = API-only, 1 seat; Team = API + basic support, 5 seats; Scale = SLA + burst; include an explicit migration note for Dedicated.
jen_legal: I'll review EULA and trial clause. Important: trials must expire automatically (no auto-billing), have a 30-day data retention/flush policy, and an export-control statement for restricted flows. Send me the exact SKU copy and region list.
maria_finance: For pricing I need estimated token burn per tier and suggested overage CPM. Also specify whether trial credits count toward startup credits or are separate.
luis_ops: For onboarding creds: for each cloud we need the target account contact + intended cloud account IDs. Quick checklist:
- AWS: role ARN + external-id
- GCP: service account email (we'll provide least-priv key)
- Azure: service principal + tenant id
I can script the PR to generate the publisher guides once I have emails.
sara_partnerships: I'll collate into a single shared doc. Action list: Alan -> finalize SKU bullets and migration line; Mark -> initial prices; Maria -> overage guidance; Jen -> legal paragraph and EULA redline; Luis -> creds guide once accounts provided.
mark_sales: FYI: gov/regional customers may need entitlement exceptions. tagging @maria_finance for potential pricing waivers.
maria_finance: A note on billing: marketplace commissions vary by cloud and region. We'll publish net price and distributor fee separately. I'll add a column for expected net-to-company.
jen_legal: Quick template I'll add: "Trial: expires automatically at end of trial period. No automatic charge without explicit consent. Retention: ephemeral trial data removed within 30 days unless customer opts in." Will also add a short export-control clause.
alan_product: Also recommend we include a short FAQ entry about data residency and log retention for marketplace customers.
mark_sales: Can we include a promo code handling row? some partner pilots require codes for trial access.
sara_partnerships: Good call. I'll add promo-code field and a notes column for pilot exceptions.
catalog-bot: Created playbook checklist https://redwood.internal/catalog/playbook/1790123456 10 items: sku-table, pricing-model, trial-policy, legal-redline, asset-pack, creds-request, promo-code, migration-note, billing-net, publisher-guide.
sara_partnerships: I'll get the doc up by EOD and ping for final signoff tomorrow. :thumbsup:
